system.description:
Effect: Projects a specific illusory or holographic scene in an immediate area up to a short distance away from you. The scene remains in place after it is created, and it includes appropriate movement, sound, and scent. For example, the scene might contain a ferocious wolf that paces back and forth but doesn’t leave the area. The scene lasts until you use a one-hour or longer recovery.

Roll to determine the image.
